pins.definition: A building where a person or family lives, or the place where one lives.
A building where a person or family lives.
A building in which people live, whether a single-family house or an apartment block.

situation: A family of four stands together outside the front door of their brightly lit suburban dwelling at dusk.
subject: the family home
brief: A cozy, two-story family home sits squarely in the frame with warm golden light spilling from every downstairs window, while a small chimney puffs a gentle spiral of blue smoke against the evening sky.
